headline: Rough patch risk 12% in the next 7 days, mostly from the treatment calendar
summary: Risk of a rough patch in the next 7 days: 12% (alert line 11%). The treatment calendar alone gives 14%; wearable signals move it -2 points. No wearable signal is out of line; the risk comes from where they are in treatment.

evidence.text: Skipped the last 7 daily check-ins. Across the program, people who come back after 5+ skips report a rough day 1.8x as often; today's wearable estimate: 2% chance today is rough (typical 6%)

evidence.text: Day 1 of cycle 4 (IV chemo every 21 days). The calendar alone predicts 14% risk of a rough patch this week.

recommendations.action: Check in before the usual low point after their dose: energy, eating, fluids. Lower this week's goals.
recommendations.why: Their treatment calendar puts them near the low point, when rough patches usually start.
